recipes.name: Margarita Beef Skewers
ingredients_raw: 1 pound top sirloin steak, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
8 metal skewers, or bamboo skewers soaked in water for 30 minutes
1 large red or green bell pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces

steps.text: Combine margarita mix, salt, sugar, garlic, and vegetable oil in a bowl or resealable plastic bag. Toss sirloin cubes in marinade and marinate at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill for medium heat.

Assemble skewers, alternating meat with mushrooms, onion, and bell pepper. Brush skewers with marinade, then discard the remaining marinade. Grill skewers to desired doneness, about 10 minutes total for medium.

raw_recipe.headline: Margarita Beef Skewers
raw_recipe.description: These skewers are quick and easy to make and taste terrific. With tender top sirloin, you don't need to marinate a long time to tenderize the meat, just long enough to impart the flavors of the citrus and garlic marinade. Serve over rice.

review.reviewBody: I doubled the amount of garlic right away. While these were marinating, I made myself a margarita. My son and husband loved the skewers, daughter didn't care for them, and I loved my margarita a lot more, I'm afraid. I found the meat to be too sweet, and needed an extra shake of garlic salt once they were done. I would've given it 3 stars, but like I said, my boys loved it.

The first time I tried this, I followed the recipe exactly and it was OK. The second time I tweaked it to my tastes and it was very good. I omitted the sugar, minced 8 large garlic cloves, added a pinch of black pepper and a tablespoon of red pepper flakes, then marinated it at room temp for 2 hours. Delicious!

Husband states very good though not superb. He's a little spoiled by some other recipes from this site. Nontheless I will make this again when in the mood for skewers. Added 2 tbsp lime juice and some minced garlic. Followed another reviewer's suggestion of marinating the bamboo skewers in the marinade. We liked small dipping bowls of the marinade on the side. Served with chilled sliced tomatoes drizzled with a little blue cheese dressing. More sides would have been too much. Will experiment with this marinade with chicken and with pork.

I made it per the recipe less the sugar, only because I think the margarita mix is sweet enough. I marinated the meat for about 2 hours. It was really good, but I think it could have been even better if it was left in the marinade overnight. The flavor was great, just not quite strong enough in my opinion. But I'm definitely going to try it again. Thanks for the recipe.

I marinated the meat with the salt, garlic, etc. I then put the mushrooms on a skewer, bell peppers on a skewer and onions on a skewer. I basted the veggies with the marinade a couple of times while it all sat. Oh, I added 1.5 limes to the mix, as I like limes and two chopped up jalapenos.

Great recipe, YUM! . Added the 1/4 Tequila, great idea! The meat turns out a little tough if you over cook it (so be careful)..Marinating it longer may help too, next time I will. Cooking veggies on separate skewer than meat is a good idea. Thanks for sharing
I didn’t add the extra sugar, and I added the teaspoon of red pepper flakes. I marinared the beef for 2-1/2 hours. It turned out well. My husband loved it, said that I could make it every week!
Fantastic recipe - the steak really picked up the flavor of the marinade. I soaked the bamboo skewers for 30 minutes in the marinade as well prior to threading them.

Okay, I tweaked the recipe right away. I added tequila to the recipe and I included chicken kabobs as well. The beef was really good but I admit the chicken seasoned and absorbed the marinate much better. I also did veggie kabobs and they were great also. PLEASE use 1/4 cup of tequila you will be much happier with the end result.
I've made this recipe several times now and we've used pork and chicken in it too. Easy and excellent. I'd like to try the strawberry margarita mix with chicken and see what happens...
We tried it as written Great! Yet we added a 1/4 cup of lime juice to the left over marinade in the slip lock bag, and used this little dab to brush the skewers.
Turn out perfect, just the right taste of margarita. Very tender and went great with the veggies. I will be making this again and when we have a few friends over.
Very delicious, husband like them too. The only thing I did was add extra garlic and didn’t make with mushrooms. Soaked skewers in water for 30 minutes prior to grilling and assembling
It was really good. I was a little skeptical about it. Did not add any sugar added extra garlic. Next time I think I’ll add lime juice as well
Delicious even though we overcooked them.
marinade needs to be kicked up a notch, hard to savor it after grilling.
Super quick and easy. The Margarita mix keeps a subtle flavor to the meat. I’d make it again
I thought it was perfect with NO changes.
too easy to turn out so good.

Made this dish just like the recipe said. The kabobs were delicious! I let my ingredients marinade all day in the refrigerator and when I skewered them up I put the vegetables on separate skewers. I will definitely make these again!
